Global context.ValueIsFilled

Global context

ValueIsFilled

Available since version 8.1.

Syntax:

ValueIsFilled(<Value>)

Parameters:

<Value> (required)

Type: Arbitrary.
Value for test.

Returned value:

Type: Boolean.
Value type Boolean always return True.
Value type String returns True, if a string contains non-space characters. Arrays and collections return True, if they contain at least 1 item.
For Undefined and Null values, the False is always returned.

Description:

Function checks whether the passed value is different from default value of the same type.
Does not work with mutable values. The function calls an exception if mutable value is passed.

Availability:

Thin client, web-client, mobile client, server, thick client, external connection, mobile application (client), mobile application (server), mobile standalone server.

Note:

Data source is not checked, value is always considered filled.

Available since:

Available since version 8.1.
